definitions.explanation: Seven of something counted with {個|こ}, the broadest of the object counters. Typically used for compact, self-contained things such as fruit, eggs, or boxes.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七個|ななこ}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たまご⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{七個|ななこ}⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are seven eggs left in the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{三個|さんこ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{七個|ななこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: At three each per person, seven isn't enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八個|はっこ}だった⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七個|ななこ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だった。
examples.english: I was sure I ordered eight, but only seven arrived.

notes:
⟦{七|なな}→七：00734_nana⟧ + the counter ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧. The reading is ななこ; しちこ is not used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {七個|ななこ}{入|い}り: a pack of seven
- {七個|ななこ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: seven each
- {七個|ななこ}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the seventh one

NOTE ON THE SERIES: the 〜⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ counter is regular except for ⟦{一個|いっこ}→一個：08922_ikko⟧, {六個|ろっこ}, {八個|はっこ}, and {十個|じゅっこ}, which take small-tsu sound changes. {七個|ななこ} keeps the plain reading.
